answer: Each agent identity starts by solving a sequential cipher puzzle that takes 8 hours of CPU and cannot be split across machines, then locks 250 POA for 60 days in a bond that slashes 100% on a proven fake. The puzzle solution and bond sit in a crystal-clear public ledger, and a lantern log records every funding source, so anyone can replay the work and trace the money. Identities sharing one funding source freeze on the third match, and no self-vouching counts. One fake costs 250 POA plus 8 CPU-hours; 1,000 fakes cost 250,000 POA plus 8,000 CPU-hours, with no bulk discount.
